name: DevT Pro
tagline: Essential developer tools in one fast, offline app
blurb: DevT Pro brings more than 100 everyday developer tools into one fast, keyboard-friendly desktop app.
description:
DevT Pro brings more than 100 everyday developer tools into one fast,
keyboard-friendly desktop app. Convert, format, validate, inspect and
generate data without sending anything to a server.

• Convert between JSON, XML, YAML, CSV, TSV, TOML and TOON

• Generate Java, C#, TypeScript, Python, Dart and Kotlin models from JSON

• Format, minify and validate JSON, XML, YAML, SQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript

• Encode and decode URLs, Base64 and JWTs, with tree and table viewers for structured data

• Generate hashes, encrypt text, and create UUIDs, ULIDs, passwords and secret keys

• Test regular expressions, compare text, convert timestamps and parse cron expressions

• Generate and read QR codes

Quickly find any tool with the command palette, work across multiple tabs,
and drag files directly into supported editors.

DevT Pro is paid software: a license key must be purchased and activated
before the app can be used. Without one, no tools are available. The app
links to where a key can be bought.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
